name: Spec Driven
author: Kandown
description: A requirements-first workflow that applies project principles, creates a testable specification and technical plan, then executes dependency-aware tasks with traceability.
summary: Turn principles and requirements into a traceable plan, task graph, and verified implementation.

taskTemplates.name: Specification
taskTemplates.description: Defines prioritized user stories, requirements, scenarios, edge cases, and measurable outcomes.

taskTemplates.name: Technical plan

taskTemplates.name: Dependency task
taskTemplates.description: Implements one dependency-aware outcome with requirement and acceptance traceability.
